O02

Optional staff achievement authoring

/teach/courses/:courseId/achievements/manage
Roles: instructor, taScope: optionalPriority: optional

Specify optional transparent recognition criteria and instructor-controlled issuance/correction without affecting course grades.

W35 optional tools entryO01 correction request handoff

CriteriaPublished requirements, allowed evidence and effective version
ReviewEligible learner facts, issuance/revocation preview and audit history

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Issue or correct award
  • Recipients, criterion/evidence versions and learner-visible reason
  • Recognition does not add grade points or change release
Return without applying changesConfirm reviewed recognition
Permissions
  • Instructor controls opt-in, issuance and corrections if this optional feature is later adopted.
  • TA may draft only under explicit course authoring scope and expiry; no issuance or grade policy authority.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • TA drafting cannot issue, revoke or enable awards.
  • Criterion edits do not retroactively erase earned records.
  • Stale eligibility preview blocks issuance and requires fresh review.
Notes
  • OPTIONAL proposal only; not adopted or implemented. No automated award engine is authorised.
  • Default off; award rules remain separate from structured grading policy. No external badge service or paid provider selected.
  • TA authoring is disabled in initial HTML; listed authoring actions require a separately approved future grant.
